description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {R} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying at least {3}{R}{R}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it at least +5/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Fanning the Flames.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

uses.name: Empowered Autogenerator
uses.cardState: with four or more charge counters on it
